SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password_hash, u.nickname, u.phone, u.company_id, u.status, u.password_changed_at, f.storage_key AS avatar_storage_key
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id = u.avatar_file_id AND f.owner_id = u.id AND f.status = 1 AND f.purpose = 'AVATAR'
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT r.code
FROM user_roles ur
INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.status = 1
INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1
WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY r.code ASC
SELECT id FROM roles WHERE code = 'USER' AND scope = 'SELF' AND status = 1
